description: This file contains utility functions for theme management and color manipulation in a Mattermost Redux-based project, including theme default setting, color blending, and contrast calculation.

methods.name: makeStyleFromTheme
methods.description: Creates a memoized style object based on a theme, updating only when the theme changes.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Parses a color string (RGB or hex) into its red, green, blue, and alpha components.

methods.name: changeOpacity
methods.description: Adjusts the opacity of a given color and returns the color in rgba format.

methods.name: blendColors
methods.description: Blends two colors with a specified opacity, returning either hex or rgba format.

methods.name: setThemeDefaults
methods.description: Sets default values for theme properties, supporting theme type mapping and backward compatibility.

methods.name: getContrastingSimpleColor
methods.description: Returns black or white depending on the luminance of the input color for contrast.
